plan: Given my private value of $12, I aim to bid slightly below my value to maximize profit while minimizing potential loss. Considering worst-case scenarios, I should avoid bidding above $12 to prevent negative profit. A bid of $11.8 strategically positions me to potentially win while ensuring any profit is maximized if I do win. This bid is competitive without exceeding my value, thus minimizing risk.

Given my value of $45, I aim to bid just below the maximum to ensure profit if I win. The worst-case scenario is winning with a bid equal to or higher than my value, resulting in no profit. To maximize profit while minimizing risk, I will bid slightly below my value, ensuring I only win if others bid lower. A bid of $44.9 should maximize profit potential while minimizing the risk of overbidding.

Given my private value of $5, I aim to minimize my losses as winning will not yield significant profit. The worst-case scenario for any bid above $5 is paying more than the item's value, resulting in a net loss. Thus, I will bid low to avoid winning. This protects against overbidding and ensures my bid is below competitors' likely higher bids.
